questions.prompt: A partner assumes you agree with a plan. Clarify your actual position and check what they propose instead.
questions.context:
A partner suggests meeting today and assumes you agree. You do not agree to today; you suggest tomorrow instead. The partner’s availability tomorrow is unknown. Correct the assumption and ask about that missing detail.
Familiar meanings available: to agree; to consent; disagree; think or assume, often with a mistaken belief; suggest; suggestion.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I acknowledged the partner’s proposal accurately.
I corrected the assumption and invited a relevant response.

questions.prompt: Write a short explanation of the familiar decision for a partner who missed the discussion.
questions.context:
Two partners discussed meeting today or tomorrow. Today one partner has no free time; both have free time tomorrow. They decided to meet tomorrow for that reason. Explain this decision to the absent third partner.
Familiar meanings available: to believe; to think; reason; cause; because; owing to; therefore; as a result.
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: A stated reason supports that viewpoint.
